questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign, traffic is moving toward you. Do not drive toward this sign—turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before you turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign warns drivers about school zones. Some of these signs mark school crossings where children and pedestrians may be present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit if conditions are not ideal. Always adjust your speed for weather and road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means an intersection is coming up. Look carefully for traffic from other directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that tells drivers what they must do. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive with caution in these conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If you drift off the road and a wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way paths with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming up. Begin slowing down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of an upcoming winding road. Adjust your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits turns in the direction shown by the arrow. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round sign indicates a railroad crossing ahead. This sign is posted several hundred feet before the tracks to tell drivers to slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns that a divided highway is starting. You should keep to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow triangular sign with black lettering marks a no passing zone. It appears on the left side of two-lane roads where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of low clearance. It shows the height distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings tells you a stop sign is coming up. Slow down and prepare to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what rules they must follow. Where this sign is posted, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to conditions ahead. It warns that you are leaving a one-way highway and entering a two-way highway where traffic moves in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop and wait until it is safe before proceeding through the intersection.
